name: Code Theme Synchronizer
description: Harmonizes VS Code, VSCodium, and Antigravity IDE themes and colors with Hyprconf obsidian palettes and wallpaper accents.
author: shell-ninja
tagline: Live theme & obsidian palette synchronization for VS Code, VSCodium & Antigravity IDE
features: Zero-Restart Live Injection: Injects color tokens directly into running editor sessions.

Terminal ANSI Synchronization: Matches integrated editor terminal colors with Kitty terminal.
Safe & Non-Destructive: Automatic backup and instant restore on uninstallation.
